dog.description_text:
💙 MEET DUKE! 💙

🎂 Age: 8 months⚖️ Weight: 25 lbs.🐾 Breed: Mixed Breed

Meet Duke, a happy 25-pound guy who's pretty much the perfect size—not too big, not too small, and at 8 months old, he probably doesn't have a whole lot more growing to do…

Unless, of course, you feed him lots. 😂🍗

Duke has the kind of personality that makes fitting into a family look easy.

🐶 Other dogs? He's good with them!🐱 Cats? Apparently they're not worth his time—he ignores them. 😂👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Loves People
dog.name: DUKE
